author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty-Seven! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

 Do you love Orcs and Goblins? Have you ever thought, I need to assert yourself in the local swamp community to better serve your mental health? Do you just want to see a troll pick up a gobin and hit another goblin with it? Old school vibes, new school rules. This might be for you. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE : https://hillgiant.itch.io/cauldron
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 067 - Cauldron by  HILL GIANT

author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
With a huge sandstorm closing in, the Eternal Dynasty set an ambush for the advancing Human Defence Force as their colonel finally makes planetfall. The DZ is under attack and the humans must hunker down to defend themselves as the Dynasty forces lay siege. 

Check out all the rules free HERE: https://onepagerules.com/games/grimdark-future
